scripts.test: bun run test:deps:ci & deps_pid=$!; bun run test:lint & lint_pid=$!; bun run test:unit:ci & unit_pid=$!; bun run test:type & type_pid=$!; wait $deps_pid; deps_status=$?; wait $lint_pid; lint_status=$?; wait $unit_pid; unit_status=$?; wait $type_pid; type_status=$?; [ $deps_status -eq 0 ] && [ $lint_status -eq 0 ] && [ $unit_status -eq 0 ] && [ $type_status -eq 0 ]
scripts.test:deps:ci: bun outdated | grep -vE '\-\-\-|Package|bun' | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*/ | /g; s/[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*$//'
